races.paceDynamic: Wedgewood and Coast will duel for the early lead in this sprint, creating an honest gallop from the off. Four horses want prominent positions (Darkened Edge, Anglesey Lad, Nordic Glory, Payforanother Daay) creating congestion and potential traffic problems approaching the final 2f. The pace pressure from two determined front-runners should set up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses. This race shape strongly favours the closers - Up The Anti, Neptune Legend, and Alyara can benefit from the anticipated strong pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Wedgewood and Coast engage in a prolonged speed duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will drain both leaders, allowing the patient hold-up horses to pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Up The Anti and Neptune Legend are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Wedgewood breaks cleanly and establishes an uncontested lead while Coast settles behind
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to control fractions and kick clear, with Coast perfectly placed to follow through. Wedgewood's recent form suggests he can sustain the effort over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners create a wall across the track entering the final 2f
scenarios.body: The pace will be moderate but positioning becomes crucial, with horses getting checked and having to switch lines late. Those drawn wide or with tactical speed can navigate the congestion best.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Sprint Battle
scenarios.trigger: If all runners maintain their positions without significant pace pressure early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure speed from the 2f pole, favouring those with the highest cruising speed ratings. The form horses with proven 5f ability can assert their class advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Quilt stands alone as the confirmed front-runner, returning from a 174-day absence but with no pace pressure from this field. Just A Gambler and Halla Bil Zain will settle prominently behind the leader, while the remaining four runners all prefer to be held up. With minimal early pace and only one natural leader, Quilt can dictate comfortable fractions throughout the early and middle stages. This lack of pace pressure and abundance of hold-up horses clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Quilt handles the firm ground and gets soft early fractions
scenarios.body: The lone leader can dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back with most rivals needing to come from behind. Hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Gambler or Halla Bil Zain track the leader closely and outstay Quilt
scenarios.body: The prominent racers can position perfectly behind the leader and have enough in reserve for a telling strike in the final furlong. Their superior recent form gives them the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and suits closers despite the tactical setup
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to stay closer than usual and launch sustained challenges. Foothold or Sup Of Red benefit from their recent runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Quilt struggles after the long layoff and the race becomes a crawl
scenarios.body: With minimal pace throughout, the race becomes a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most. The better recent performers can capitalise on the lack of tempo.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Quilt shows any signs of ring-rustiness early, as 174 days off is significant even for a front-runner
Monitor Just A Gambler's early positioning as he holds the key tactical advantage if tracking Quilt closely
Check how aggressively the hold-up horses are ridden early, as they may need to race closer than usual
Watch Halla Bil Zain's jumping from the stalls given the importance of early positioning in this tactical setup
Observe if any of the prominent horses challenge Quilt early, which could change the entire complexion

races.paceDynamic: Knightmare will set a moderate gallop from the front with Endofastorm and Lady Aiyana providing support in the prominent positions. The small field and distance creates a sustainable tempo that won't truly test the leaders until the final three furlongs. With three hold-up horses (Virtual Hug, Moon Over The Sea, Basilette) needing room to manoeuvre late, the pace scenario becomes crucial. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and early leaders who can dictate terms without genuine pressure through the middle stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Knightmare maintains a steady gallop without being pressed by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The leaders get an easy time of it through the middle stages and have enough left to resist the late challengers. Hold-up horses find the pace too honest when they need it most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly sedate and the hold-up horses get perfect splits
scenarios.body: Virtual Hug and Moon Over The Sea can unleash their finishing kicks to sweep past tiring leaders. The small field creates gaps for late runners to exploit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Endofastorm or Lady Aiyana apply early pressure to Knightmare
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly and the prominent runners drop back the leaders while staying ahead of the closers. Mid-race positioning proves decisive in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Stayer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Basilette finds significant improvement stepping up in trip on more suitable ground
scenarios.body: The longest-priced runner benefits from the strong pace and gets first run on the field. Recent winning form over extended distances translates to this longer Bath test.

races.paceDynamic: This race presents a fascinating pace puzzle with all nine runners carrying hold-up styles, yet Atalanta Mist has shown front-running tendencies and will likely go forward by default. With no confirmed pace-setters, the early gallop should be modest to steady, potentially allowing Lucky Sevens or Montu to press closer than usual. The lack of genuine pace angle means the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning and timing become crucial. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position handily and sustain their effort, rather than pure hold-up performers who rely on strong early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lucky Sevens and Montu position prominently behind a steady pace
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows tactically-positioned horses to control their own destiny, with sustained finishing kicks proving decisive over pure late pace. Horses with recent form over similar trips and proven ability to quicken off moderate fractions hold the edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Atalanta Mist gets an uncontested lead and sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The absence of pace pressure allows the front runner to dictate terms and steal a march, with the field left flat-footed by the time they organize a challenge. Her recent third on firm ground suggests she can capitalize on favorable circumstances.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where pure acceleration matters most, favoring horses with the best turn of foot regardless of position. Recent winners and horses showing sharp late pace in handicaps become dangerous.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites are caught out by positioning or the modest pace
scenarios.body: Competitive handicappers with decent recent form can capitalize when the race develops into a tactical scramble rather than a test of pure class. Horses showing consistency at this level become live chances.

runners_data.name: Grand Harbour
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who gets his chance to control from the front without pace pressure

races.paceDynamic: Grand Harbour will take the field along from the front with Man Is King the only other horse likely to race prominently early, leaving the other six runners settling behind in midfield or worse. With just one confirmed front runner, Grand Harbour can dictate terms at a sustainable gallop without early pressure, though Man Is King may track close enough to apply some tempo. The lack of pace pressure early means the race will likely develop into a sprint finish from the 3f pole, with runners fanning wide looking for racing room. This scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best when the pace lifts late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Grand Harbour gets an easy lead and Man Is King settles second without applying pressure
scenarios.body: Grand Harbour can control the fractions completely and prove hard to peg back when the field comes hunting. The lack of early pace allows him to save energy for the business end where his recent course form becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the field bunches heading into the straight
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a furious late gallop that plays to their strengths. Graffiti and Blue Hero can use their class edge when it becomes a pure speed contest in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midrace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Man Is King decides to press Grand Harbour from the 6f pole onwards
scenarios.body: This creates a more even pace that doesn't completely favour any particular style but makes stamina important. Ciotog and My O My benefit from a more genuinely run contest that tests staying power at this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Grand Harbour and Man Is King fail to establish any tempo whatsoever
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy crawl that turns into an all-out sprint, potentially suiting the most athletic finishers regardless of rating. Baynoona's recent form spike could prove decisive in a pure speed test finish.

watchPoints.text: Grand Harbour's ability to sustain his lead kick - if he quickens clear at the 2f pole, the race is over
Man Is King's positioning in the early stages - whether he tracks or presses will determine the overall tempo
The gap that opens between the front pair and the hold-up horses - if it exceeds 6-8 lengths, the closers are in trouble
Blue Hero's market support given his 225-day absence - any confidence would be significant
How quickly the field spreads across the track in the straight - bunching favours the hold-up horses
